title: Annealed correlation and quenched noise sensitivity in biased deep neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.27983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In earlier work by Jonasson, Steif and Zetterqvist (2023), fully connected deep neural networks with layers of width $n$, i.i.d.\ standard Gaussian weights, sign activations and no bias terms were shown to be annealed and quenched noise sensitive with respect to any joint probability distribution $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}$ on the input $\boldsymbol{\omega}$ and its perturbation $\boldsymbol{\eta}$ satisfying a mild positive-correlation condition and $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}(\boldsymbol{\eta} \in \{\boldsymbol{\omega},-\boldsymbol{\omega}\}) \to 0$. Here we add independent Gaussian biases of the natural order and show that quenched noise sensitivity is retained over a broad range of depths, indeed under the slightly weaker assumption that $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}(\boldsymbol{\omega} = \boldsymbol{\eta}) \to 0$. translated_title: 含偏置深度神经网络中的退火相关性与淬火噪声敏感性
translated_abstract: 在Jonasson、Steif和Zetterqvist（2023）的早期工作中，已经证明了每层宽度为 $n$、权重为独立同分布标准高斯、使用符号激活且不含偏置项的全连接深度神经网络，对于输入 $\boldsymbol{\omega}$ 及其扰动 $\boldsymbol{\eta}$ 上任何满足温和正相关条件且 $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}(\boldsymbol{\eta} \in \{\boldsymbol{\omega},-\boldsymbol{\omega}\}) \to 0$ 的联合概率分布 $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}$ 而言，都是退火和淬火噪声敏感的。本文中，我们加入了自然数量级的独立高斯偏置项，并证明在相当广泛的深度范围内淬火噪声敏感性依然保持，实际上只需稍弱的假设 $\mathbb{Q}^{(n)}(\boldsymbol{\omega} = \boldsymbol{\eta}) \to 0$。因此，在正相关条件下，淬火噪声敏感性在最弱要求下即成立，即扰动输入渐近……
tldr: 本文证明在给深度神经网络加入独立高斯偏置项后，淬火噪声敏感性在广泛的深度范围内依然成立，且只需扰动输入与原输入相等的概率趋于零这一更弱的假设。
en_tdlr: Adding independent Gaussian biases to deep neural networks preserves quenched noise sensitivity across a broad range of depths, under the weaker assumption that the probability of the perturbed input equaling the original input tends to zero.
